mapper.insert: INSERT INTO card ( member_id, card_number, card_alias, is_primary, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{cardNumber}, #{cardAlias}, #{isPrimary}, 'ACTIVE', NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM card WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT card_number FROM card WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_primary = 1 AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
